result:
Perfect. I have all the evidence. The app serves only `/healthz` and `/ready` endpoints (returns 200), but the deployment's readiness probe is checking `/nope` which returns 404.

```
ROOT CAUSE: Readiness probe path is misconfigured as /nope instead of /ready

EVIDENCE:
  - kubectl describe pod demo-app-d4c8c58dd-6rblp -> Readiness: http-get http://:8080/nope, probe failed with statuscode: 404
  - kubectl get events -> Warning Unhealthy: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404 (repeated)
  - kubectl get deploy demo-app -o yaml -> spec.template.spec.containers[0].readinessProbe.httpGet.path: /nope (current), but annotation shows original was /ready
  - kubectl get configmap demo-app-code -o yaml -> app code shows only /healthz and /ready return 200, all other paths return 404
  - kubectl logs demo-app-d4c8c58dd-6rblp -> app is healthy: "db reachable", no errors

CONFIDENCE: high

PROPOSED PATCH:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: demo-app
  namespace: rca-test
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 3
          periodSeconds: 5
```
